title: SeverActions
tagline: An action, prompt, and behavior pack for SkyrimNet
description:
SeverActions extends SkyrimNet with actions, prompts, and a native SKSE plugin that together let NPCs act on what they say. They follow you and travel across Skyrim, craft and cook and brew, manage their outfits, handle gold and debt, sit down, fight, get arrested and escorted to jail, settle disputes with fists, run businesses for you, and remember what happened.

One principle runs through all of it: the AI decides what to do, and the mod makes it happen in-game — with the engine's own systems, not around them.
author: severause
changelog:
## SeverActions 4.0.2 — Hotfix

Updates the bundled **Magelight UI to 0.30.3**, which fixes three problems in 4.0.1:

**Fixed: crash at startup with Community Shaders**, or a few minutes into play with ENB or an upscaler (`d3d11.dll` in the crash log)
**Fixed: crash at startup with ENB** that left no crash log
**Fixed: menu cut off** on screens under ~1067 pixels tall (1366×768, 1600×900)

If you made a `Magelight.json` to work around the ENB crash, you can delete it now.

**Installing:** install over 4.0.1 and choose **Replace**. Your saves load as they are.
